description: Generate a high-converting ad creative — hero image + a platform-optimized feed crop for Meta / social ads.

inputs.name: product_or_service
inputs.description: What is being advertised (e.g. "SaaS project management tool for remote teams").

inputs.name: target_audience
inputs.description: Who the ad is for (e.g. "startup founders aged 25-40, tech-savvy").

inputs.name: campaign_goal
inputs.description: Campaign objective - awareness, consideration, or conversion.

phases.prompt: {{tone}}, advertising photography, clean background, product focus, ultra detailed, commercial quality. Advertisement for {{product_or_service}} targeting {{target_audience}}. Capture the product/service benefit and a lifestyle cue for the audience, matching campaign goal: {{campaign_goal}}.
Reframe for Facebook/Instagram feed ad format (1080x1080). Keep product/subject centered and uncropped. Maintain original palette and tone. Leave headroom/footroom for text overlays.
